correctness.rationale: Distance from core landmark c_a to cycle c_i is d_C(a,i), to its leaf ℓ_i is d_C(a,i)+1. Cross-layer ambiguity occurs only if all core landmarks lie within an m-vertex consecutive arc (equivalent to a cyclic gap >=m+1). Thus valid triples are exactly gap vectors g_i≥1,g_i≤m,sum 2m; subtract unique long-gap count from binom(2m,3) to obtain m(m−1)(m+4)/3. Legal unit transfers between donor/receiver gaps preserve [1,m], reduce target L1; for m>=3 reach (m−1,m−1,2) and use front-to-back slides for a repeatable clockwise labelled patrol; for m2 four triples form the vacancy-sliding cycle. Moving a core robot out/back to its leaf preserves distinct signatures. Explicit two-projection witness configurations show no resolving pairs for m>=3; for m2 four adjacent-leaf pairs resolve but freeze when moving inward. Independent BFS on n=4,6,8,10,12 confirmed all pairs, 210 valid core triples total, the gap iff, allowed pendant detours and connected legal configurations. General proof, not extrapolation, supplies all m.
